The Pale Harvest quest is complete. I killed the drowned sailor and captain at the wreck, took the strongbox key and opened the strongbox. Inside was a Kothringi Keystone, which I brought to Nesh-Deeka. She paid me 100 gold.

She did not know the carving herself. She said it is Kothringi and that the Chime-Keepers of Toklea, in the Tulmek Washes, keep what is left of Kothringi lore. Their elder should know it. That is the next lead.

I still don't know what seal paste, Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel or Umbriel are. I also don't know how Nesh-Deeka learns what the Unbound do. When I asked, she only said "we listen." The game has accepted my final notes and is over.
